content: <thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups in the unknown sample, I will first obtain its ¹³C NMR spectrum using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical‑shift ranges with `retrieve_carbon_shifts` to identify the region where methyl carbons appear (≈10–30 ppm). By counting how many peaks in the spectrum fall within that range, I can infer the number of CH₃ groups. If no peaks are found in the methyl region, the answer will be 0.
